dialogues.speaker: Chisseray
dialogues.text: How wonderful to not be doing research...

dialogues.speaker: Chisseray
dialogues.text: I was. But I don't do that now. I just help Mr. Raimondo by organizing files and documents.

dialogues.speaker: Chisseray
dialogues.text: Looking back, I should have quit way earlier and let that old fool Bossuet write his own boring papers... It's the only thing he's good for anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Chisseray
dialogues.text: I was. But since quitting Bossuet's team, I'm an honorary researcher at best. Of course, that means I rank below you, as you're an Honorary Senior Researcher.

dialogues.speaker: Chisseray
dialogues.text: Anyway, I don't do that now. I just help Mr. Raimondo by organizing files and documents.

dialogues.speaker: Chisseray
dialogues.text: Looking back, I should have quit way earlier and let that old fool Bossuet write his own boring papers... It's the only thing he's good for anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Chisseray
dialogues.text: See you. And if you run into Bossuet, stay away from him.

dialogues.speaker: Chisseray
dialogues.text: He's an old fogey whose vision has already started to go, a researcher without an ounce of creativity, an honorary clothes rack that thinks the world of himself, a bloodsucker who feeds on the research of others and is utterly useless without his subordinates.

dialogues.speaker: Chisseray
dialogues.text: He is. And if I'd realized sooner how "special" he is and made up my mind to quit, my life would have been much easier.

dialogues.speaker: Chisseray
dialogues.text: But never mind. I'm not a researcher now and I'm getting my life back on track. And that's enough for me.
